digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot startup composition and operation-scoped config/auth isolation (RP-04 S5)
propositions: MCP and review-bot static startup policy (Gerrit/GitHub/LLM provider bindings, LLMRuntime) must be composed once at process initialization and remain frozen across all operations, while per-operation non-secret config is freshly composed for each request.
Inbound MCP bearer tokens remain request-scoped context and must never appear in startup bindings, operation snapshots, serialization, logs, caches, or subprocess environments.

Review-bot decision-bearing auth (Gerrit/GitHub credentials) must be validated before accepting a job or webhook, with no fallback to alternate principals; only the selected integration is constructed and passed to the operation.
Static binding mutations (env/file changes) are observed only after process restart/redeploy; native SDK-owned refreshable capabilities remain independent.
Partial or rejected Langfuse/OTLP telemetry credentials disable telemetry collection without altering the underlying operation result; security-bearing auth remains fail-closed.
LLMRuntime from startup bindings must be threaded through review_and_vote→_decision_for_clone→code_review_decision so each adapter receives the composed runtime.
